name: 56-t20-pan-lit-stays-day
incident: 2026-10-07 negative of scenario 55: the reachable-maximum rule must not fire in a lit scene
description: Same T20 isp_info camera as scenario 55 (analog cap 128, ISP digital gain unused, so night_gain 4096 is out of reach and the plateau rule is armed). Daylight at base gain, then a dim room at 8x analog gain with the integration time at 87.6 % (index 1794, inside the day_gain..night_gain band), then the analog cap with only 25 % integration time (index 1024: at the cap, but its plateau bar 973 does not clear 1.5 x day_gain, so a probe would read the same scene below day_gain and undo the switch), then daylight again. Every phase must stay day: one switch (the boot measurement), no warning.
